theme: Dark Mode (Pure Black #000000 base, Cyan #00FFD1 accent, White text)

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight font-black uppercase font-orbitron
hierarchy.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight font-bold font-orbitron text-white

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing scale (2-3x breathing room) with asymmetrical bento layouts and crisp 1px borders
spacing_and_layout.container_padding: px-4 sm:px-8 md:px-12 lg:px-20 py-16 md:py-24
spacing_and_layout.hero_dock: Fixed bottom-8 or top-6 horizontal navigation dock with glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 border border-white/10 rounded-full px-6 py-3)
spacing_and_layout.bento_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 md:gap-8

motion_and_interactions.hero_reveal: Spline 3D onLoad listener triggers circular progress bar completion and line-by-line staggered text reveal (Framer Motion). Fallback static image view with animated scanline if Spline fails or takes long.
motion_and_interactions.ken_burns_zoom: Slow smooth zoom-in effects (Ken Burns) on close-up cybernetic robot photography cards
motion_and_interactions.hover_effects: Cards feature subtle -translate-y-1, border-[#00FFD1]/50 glow, and backdrop saturation increase
motion_and_interactions.scroll_reveals: Scroll-triggered staggered bottom fade-ins using Framer Motion initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 30 }} whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}

3d_spline_configuration.hero_layout_rule: The candidate's name is rendered directly inside the 3D scene behind the robot. DO NOT overlay a big title on top of the robot model. Keep hero UI minimal with fixed navigation dock, tagline, status indicator, and CTA.

instructions_to_main_agent.tech_stack: React js (.js / .jsx), Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Spline (@splinetool/react-spline), Lucide Icons, Sonner for toasts
instructions_to_main_agent.data_file: Create a unified mock data file (src/data/portfolioData.js) containing bio, manifesto chapters, project bento items, capabilities stack, and stats.
instructions_to_main_agent.contact_form: Connect contact form to FastAPI backend endpoint (e.g. POST /api/contact) with fallback mock success feedback via Sonner toast.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing_requirement: EVERY interactive element (buttons, links, inputs, form toggles, modal closes) MUST include a explicit data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='nav-about-link', data-testid='contact-submit-button').

GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES: Never use generic centered layouts or plain Bootstrap grids.
Avoid Inter for main section headers; use Orbitron for headings and KodeMono for labels/mono elements.
Ensure contrast APCA / WCAG compliant: text over darker surfaces must maintain high legibility.
Never use fully transparent header backgrounds; use glassmorphism with backdrop blur and subtle border.
Provide responsive mobile layouts with mobile-first grid structures.
Include hover, active, and focus states on all interactive elements with explicit text color handling.
